1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The institute may add or remove machines during the AMC period, and payment shall be adjusted on a p ro-rata basis, if applicable. 2.The AMC shall cover all types of sewing machines available in the institute, including lockstitch, overlock , interlock, buttonhole, button attaching, bar-tacking, and specialized sewing machines, as applicable. 3.Emergency maintenance visits, if required during examinations, practical assessments, exhibitions, or fa shion shows, shall be provided without extra cost 1. Inspection and Servicing: Thorough inspection, cleaning, oiling, lubrication, adjustment and servicing of all sewing machines covered under the AMC. 2. Preventive Maintenance: Periodic preventive maintenance of all machines, including checking of motors, belts, pulleys, electrical connections, switches, wiring, pedals, needles, bobbin cases, shuttle hooks and ot her mechanical components. 3. Breakdown Maintenance: Attending to all complaints regarding machine breakdowns and rectifying faul ts promptly to minimize disruption of training activities. 4. Replacement of Minor Parts: Replacement of defective or worn-out minor parts, wherever required, as p er the terms and conditions of the AMC. 5. Stitch Quality and Performance: Ensuring proper stitch formation, stitch length adjustment, thread tensi on, needle alignment and smooth operation of each machine. 6. Motor and Electrical Maintenance: Checking and repairing motors, foot controllers, speed controllers, ele ctrical connections and other related components. 7. Specialized Machine Maintenance: Maintenance and adjustment of different types of sewing machines, i ncluding single needle lockstitch, double needle, overlock, interlock, flatlock, buttonhole and button-attach ing machines, wherever available in the Institute. 8. Emergency Breakdown Support: Providing timely technical support whenever machines develop faults d uring practical classes or other institutional activities. 9. Replacement of Consumables and Spare Parts: Supplying and replacing required spare parts and consu mables as specified in the AMC agreement. Any exclusions shall be clearly mentioned in the contract.

10. Performance Testing: After every repair or servicing, each machine shall be tested to ensure smooth f unctioning and satisfactory stitching quality. 11. Maintenance Records: Maintaining a machine-wise service register indicating the date of inspection, na ture of complaint, repair carried out, parts replaced and technician's details. 12. Technician Availability: Providing qualified and experienced technicians for maintenance and repair wo rk at the Institute's premises without any additional visit charges. 13. Final Inspection: Conducting a comprehensive inspection of all machines at the end of the AMC period and submitting a maintenance and performance report to the Institute. 14. General Responsibility: The contractor shall ensure that all sewing machines remain in good working c ondition throughout the AMC period and that maintenance work does not adversely affect the Institute's re gular training schedule. 15. Compliance: All maintenance and repair work shall be carried out using genuine and compatible spare parts, following the manufacturer's recommended procedures and applicable safety standards. .
